I have been bringing both of my babies here since 2016ish when Dr. Stern was still practicing. I never really had a problem with them until 5/5/2024 when I needed to bring my nine year old pittie in to be seen asap. One day my baby boy just became instantly sick, vomiting and then partly paralyzed. Everything progressed so quickly, I knew it was severe, I then called 5 Star to try to get him seen.

I spoke with a particular receptionist over the phone and I became a bit inconsolable, rightfully so, as I explained my boy’s condition. She told me I could bring him in “tomorrow.” I pleaded with her to please let me bring him in today, as I try to express just how bad he’s doing and I inquired about euthanasia. At this point my boy had blood in his vomit and is suffering.

Not only did she answer the phone with an attitude and act like she was being inconvenienced, she also completely overstepped her boundaries and her position as a “receptionist” when she told me while being condescending “the doctors not going to just euthanize him. When she examines him there’s still no guarantee that the vet will.” She said more during that phone call but I can’t recall everything since I wasn’t in my right state of mind, knowing I’m losing my baby. I thanked her for the appointment for the following day and ended the call.

I wasn’t going to watch my boy suffer 24 more hours. My brother called around and found a wonderful vet that was able to put my baby boy to rest.

This review is solely based off that receptionist and her disgusting attitude. Her name is Veronica or something similar. Not only is she not qualified to discuss what measures his vet would take, she was also out of line and should be ashamed of herself!

Rest Easy Rocko, I love you more than anything baby boy!

I've been bringing my pets her since 2014. At 5 Star Vet they do not put pressure to pay for procedures as other vets do. They give you the breakdown of fees and procedures and it is at your own discretion to pick what you think is best based on your budget.
I brought in my 16 year old dog who had a bad cough and other issues, without paying thousands, the vet prescribed the right meds and today, my dog is way better. Cough almost went away and he is sleeping all throughout the night.
They are busy, so be kind and patient with the staff and vets.
